title: The other-checkout guard does not read a harmless python heredoc body as shell
why: The other-checkout shell scan reads words inside a python heredoc body, so text that only quotes a path or a `cp` line is refused (triage's own refusals, Nov 7-8; step other-checkout-cp-own).
note: Fix: drop a python heredoc body from the shell scan only when the body parses and names none of os, subprocess, shutil, importlib, exec, eval or __import__.
